LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 11.3.1 WORD CLASSES: ADVERBS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.3: Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs, part of Strand 11 in Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why do we form words from other words? 2. What are the functions of adverbs?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-efficacy: It is enhanced as the learner shows concerted attention to detail when forming adverbs from adjectives .

• Critical thinking: It is developed as the learner cultivates the skills of reasoning when using adverbs in sentences.

Values:
Responsibility: It is promoted as the learner demonstrates accountabilty when selecting adverbs from digital devices.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Decision making skills: These are achieved as the learner makes decisions on adverbs to use in speech and writing.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Word formation is relevant in vocabulary buiding skills in Kiswahili.
